free_tier.stated: Free Forever video plan: 60 storage minutes, 100 GB bandwidth/mo, 60 mins live streaming/mo, 1 seat. Storage minutes are minutes of uploaded video, not bytes; original images are not stored.

egress.terms: 100 GB/month bandwidth on free (generous), then metered.

tooling: REST upload plus URL transformations, S3 source pull.
chaining: Unlimited free accounts x 60 storage minutes. A video-minute is a terrible unit for binary storage: 60 min at 1080p is ~1-4 GB and everything is transcoded, never stored as original bytes.
limits_note: 60 storage mins, 100 GB/mo bandwidth, 60 mins live streaming. All assets transcoded to adaptive bitrate.
reliability_note: Transcodes by design; originals are not the delivered artifact. Unusable for byte-exact storage.

evidence.proved: Free: '60 storage mins', '100 GB bandwidth/mo', 'Free Forever'
the first-party pricing page states the Free plan's 60 storage minutes, 100 GB bandwidth and 60 live-streaming minutes
evidence.quote: Gumlet's Free Plan includes 60 storage minutes, 100 GB bandwidth, 60 minutes of live streaming

evidence.proved: the video Free plan is labelled Free Forever
uploaded videos are transcoded into multiple formats, so originals are not the delivered bytes
evidence.quote: When you upload a video, Gumlet transcodes it into multiple resolutions and formats (for example, HLS, DASH, MP4) to support adaptive playback.

notes: 60 storage minutes of video, not bytes. No meaningful free image allowance. This is a video-first CDN.

dead_end.why: 60 storage minutes of video, not bytes. No meaningful free image allowance — this is a video-first CDN.
